Japan Protests Russian Aircraft in its Airspace

Japan has lodged a protest with Russia after two suspected Russian military aircraft reportedly violated Japanese airspace. The incident prompted Japan to scramble fighter jets. The deployment of Russian military aircraft in the region is seen by some as a potent message to Asia.
